g.text: ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY · Simulated data · No measured platform performance

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #81778c

g.text: The final test is what readers understand and decide—not how persuasive a summary sounds.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #675d74

g.text: Hypothetical reader-study design: 120 cases compared across three evidence presentations.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #675d74

g.text: Paired differences isolate the comparison; calibration checks whether confidence is deserved.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #81778c

g.text: DESIGN SIMULATION — NOT RESULTS. Case-level losses and calibration curves are entirely constructed. Shifts are design examples, not predicted benefits.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #81778c

g.text: A real study needs randomized readers, a prespecified decision rule, and reader- and case-aware analysis.
